description: Deterministic tool-using retrieval workload for measuring orchestration and retrieval boundaries without model or network variance.

corpus.text: oneTBB schedules CPU tasks, parallel loops, reductions, pipelines, task arenas, and flow graphs.
oneDAL provides analytics algorithms including nearest neighbor, clustering, tables, and distributed modes.
oneDNN supplies neural network primitives, graph fusion, memory descriptors, layouts, and post operations.
oneMath supplies BLAS LAPACK RNG DFT sparse math and backend dispatch APIs.
oneDPL provides parallel algorithms and execution policies for host and SYCL device data.
oneCCL provides distributed collective communication including allreduce broadcast and communicator operations.
SYCL provides portable device selection queues kernels memory and accelerator execution.
Performance validation requires correctness gates baselines warmup repeated timing variance and hardware provenance.
Agent frameworks own planning orchestration tools application state and model interaction.
Tool calls can fan out concurrently but must preserve cancellation exceptions backpressure and result identity.
Retrieval quality must be fixed before comparing vector search latency conversion cost or routing performance.
Structured outputs require schema validation deterministic field names and explicit failure behavior.
Python integrations should be pip installable report versions and reach a verified first result quickly.
Hardware support claims require declared backend device driver runtime and fallback evidence across vendor lanes.
A benchmark negative control detects overhead when an optimization has no relevant work to accelerate.
Skill promotion requires maintainer review current sources realistic evals matched trials and retained evidence.
